mission: Expand behavioral ecology coverage through four distinct primary studies addressing frequency-dependent mating strategies, producer-scrounger foraging models, cooperative teaching in wild meerkats, and experimentally demonstrated social learning in bumblebees. Extract separately supported findings and methods, preserve species and experimental populations, distinguish model predictions from observations, retain statistical and methodological limitations, and identify research questions only where explicitly supported. Do not infer universal behavioral laws, taxonomy placement, scientific consensus, or present frontier status.
